sources.sweep: The other weights are rescaled so the sum stays 1. The interval of w_k where first place (or the whole ranking) does not change is the weight stability interval.
sources.perturb: WS compares a ranking with yours and weighs the top places most: 1 is the same ranking.
sources.monteCarlo: Weights are drawn from a Dirichlet distribution: uniform over all weight vectors, or centred on yours with concentration κ. The share of draws in which alternative i has rank r is its rank acceptability.
sources.removal: The remaining weights are divided by their sum, or CRITIC is run again without the criterion. A change of first place here is a rank reversal.
